title: Metrics for TTI/TTC/clean recovery + regulatory & bank-audit hooks
outcome: Operational, jury-verifiable definitions of TTI, TTC and clean recovery, plus a requirements table mapping regulation/audit expectations to our components
acceptance: Definitions of TTI/TTC/clean recovery grounded in ≥3 sources (e.g. NIST SP 800-61r3, Google SRE/incident metrics, MTTD/MTTR literature), with exact start/stop events and a formula for clean recovery (residual damage + collateral loss)
Requirements table: source clause (EU AI Act Art. 12/14/19/26 with current applicability dates, NIST AI RMF / AI 600-1, ≥1 banking source e.g. PRA SS1/23 or EU DORA) × requirement × our component
All regulatory citations link to official text, not vendor blogs
'Implications for our design' section specifying what the Evaluation harness must measure
summary:
Verified in the EC AI Act Service Desk consolidated Art 113 (marked AMENDED): high-risk Chapter III (Arts 12/14/19/26) applies 2 Dec 2027 (Annex III) and 2 Aug 2028 (Annex I); general date stays 2 Aug 2026. Reg number (EU) 2026/1744 is secondary-sourced; Council/EP/OJ hosts were blocked by the proxy.
NIST SP 800-61r3 has NO mean-time metrics; Google SRE says mean-time stats are poorly suited for decisions; DORA renamed MTTR in 2023. So TTI/TTC/clean recovery are ours to define. IBM: 241 days (2025), 247 days (2026, secondary), 4.99M USD (2026, IBM page).
Definitions: TTI = t0 (first bad effect commit, from fault injector) to first correct (agent_id, action_id) attribution; also alert-to-attribution and TTI-scope (blast-radius recall>=0.9). TTC = t0 to capability revoked at chokepoint AND no further bad effect under red-team probe; plus damage-in-window and collateral stall.
Clean recovery = pair (R, C): R = |bad effects still in final state|/|B| (B includes taint), C = |good effects lost|/|G|, with revert precision/recall; judged against counterfactual replay with culprit removed; CR=1-(R+C)/2 only shown with R and C; baselines: snapshot-restore and no-op.
Table maps AI Act Art 12/14/19/26, NIST AI RMF + 600-1, DORA, PRA SS1/23, RBI FREE-AI (13 Aug 2025), CERT-In (6h report, 180d logs, AI/ML in Annexure I) to Recorder/Monitor/Containment/Recovery. Open: PRA SS1/23 has a newer version effective 23 Apr 2026; confirm OJ details.
review:
[anaya · done] DONE. All 4 criteria met (TTI/TTC/clean-recovery with start/stop events grounded in NIST 800-61r3, Google SRE, DORA, IBM; requirements table with AI Act 12/14/19/26 + dates, NIST RMF/600-1, DORA, PRA, RBI, CERT-In; official-text links; harness spec). Strongest finding: no standard defines any of the jury's three metrics, so a checkable (R, C) definition is ours to offer. H8a CONFIRMED, H8b CONFIRMED and REFINED ('maps to', not 'compliant'; our system is not itself high-risk).
Spot-check: EC AI Act Service Desk Art 113 confirms 2 Dec 2027 (Annex III) and 2 Aug 2028 (Annex I), marked AMENDED by the Digital Omnibus on AI.
Carry: (1) do not cite 'Regulation (EU) 2026/1744' - number is from a vendor blog; (2) IBM 247 days is secondary; (3) RBI '18% maintained audit logs' and PRA SS1/23 clause numbers (newer version eff. 23 Apr 2026) need checking, not in RES-10 scope; (4) ground-truth B must come from the scenario oracle, never from our own taint, or the metric grades itself; (5) add 'tainted good work to re-plan' so wholesale deletion of dependents cannot score clean.
